reasoning: ECB assets have generally been on a declining trend since 2022 as the ECB has been reducing its balance sheet through quantitative tightening. Week-to-week changes can vary due to operational factors, but the overall trend has been downward. Given the QT policy environment likely still in effect in October 2026, a weekly decrease is more probable than an increase. However, short-term fluctuations can occur due to liquidity operations or other factors. The probability of an increase in any given week during QT is relatively low.
